cases.sentence: ___ будет самая простая, если старый вдовец женится на ней.
cases.translation: The wedding will be the simplest one, if the old widower marries her.
cases.explain: «Свадьба» is the subject of «будет», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: The calm beauty Lvova had arrived from abroad.
cases.explain: The compound preposition «из-за» governs the Genitive case: «из-за границы».

cases.sentence: Степан Аркадьевич рассказывал ___ свой каламбур о разводе.
cases.translation: Stepan Arkadyevich was telling his sister-in-law his pun about divorce.
cases.explain: «Свояченице» is the indirect object of «рассказывал» ("to tell someone"), hence Dative.
«Анну» is the direct object of the transitive verb «вспомнила», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: Они стояли под ___ с любовью, надеждой и страхом в сердце.
cases.translation: They stood under the wedding crown with love, hope, and fear in their hearts.
cases.explain: The preposition «под» (static location, "under") governs the Instrumental case: «под венцом».

cases.sentence: Во время обряда в ___ разряженных женщин не переставал тихий говор.
cases.translation: During the ceremony, a quiet murmur did not cease within the circle of finely dressed women.
cases.explain: «Круг» takes the special locative ending «-у» after «в»: «в кругу» (Prepositional/Locative case).

cases.sentence: «А все-таки он не стоит ее ___, не правда ли?»
cases.translation: 'Still, he's not worth her little finger, is he?'
cases.explain: The verb «стоить» ("to be worth") governs the Genitive case: «стоит пальца».

reading.ru: В церкви была вся Москва, родные и знакомые. и во время обряда обручения в блестящем освящении церкви, в кругу разряженных женщин, девушек и мужчин, в белых галстуках, фраках и мундирах, не переставал прилично тихий говор, который преимущественно затевали мужчины, между тем, как женщины были поглощены наблюдением всех подробностей, столь всегда затрогивающего их священнодействие.
reading.question: Who was present in the church for the ceremony?
options: All of Moscow society, relatives and acquaintances
reading.correct: All of Moscow society, relatives and acquaintances
reading.explain: The text says all of Moscow, relatives and acquaintances, were in the church.

reading.ru: «С ее цветом лица одно спасение», — отвечала Друбецкая.
reading.question: What did Drubetskaya say about Maria's dark dress and her complexion?
options: That it was practically her one salvation given her complexion
That it was inappropriate for a wedding
That it was the latest fashion
That it made her look younger
reading.correct: That it was practically her one salvation given her complexion
reading.explain: Drubetskaya answers that given her complexion, it was her one salvation to wear that color.

reading.ru: Я хотел десятый быть, чтобы застраховать себя, но место было занято, говорил граф Синявин хорошенькой княжне Чарской, которая имела на него виды.
reading.question: What superstition did Count Sinyavin mention about being a best man?
options: That someone who is best man more than ten times will never marry
That being best man brings good luck
That being best man means you'll marry within a year
That being best man is forbidden by the church
reading.correct: That someone who is best man more than ten times will never marry
reading.explain: They say a man who has been best man more than ten times will not marry, so Sinyavin wanted to be the tenth to protect himself, but the spot was already taken.

reading.ru: Щербацкий говорил старой фрейлине Николаевой, что он намерен надеть венец на шиньон Китти, чтобы она была счастлива.
reading.question: What did Shcherbatsky say he intended regarding Kitty's wedding crown?
options: To place the crown on Kitty's chignon so she would be happy
To refuse to attend the ceremony
To give Kitty a different crown
To hold the crown himself throughout
reading.correct: To place the crown on Kitty's chignon so she would be happy
reading.explain: Shcherbatsky tells old maid-of-honor Nikolaeva he intends to put the wedding crown on Kitty's chignon so that she will be happy.

reading.ru: Сергей Иванович говорил с Дарьей Дмитриевной, шутя, уверяя ее, что обычай уезжать после свадьбы распространяется потому, что новобрачным всегда бывает несколько совестно.
reading.question: What reason did Sergei Ivanovich jokingly give for newlyweds leaving right after the wedding?
options: Because newlyweds always feel a bit embarrassed
Because they need to catch a train
Because the parents insist on it
reading.correct: Because newlyweds always feel a bit embarrassed
reading.explain: He jokingly claims the custom of newlyweds leaving after the wedding exists because they always feel somewhat embarrassed.

reading.ru: Степан Аркадьевич рассказывал свояченице свой каламбур о разводе.
reading.question: What was Stepan Arkadyevich telling his sister-in-law?
options: A story about his own wedding
reading.explain: Stepan Arkadyevich was telling his sister-in-law his pun about divorce.

reading.ru: А это так трудно держать себя хорошо в этом положении, не быть смешным.
reading.question: How did Lvova describe Levin's behavior during the ceremony?
options: Not ridiculous or stiff, but visibly moved
reading.correct: Not ridiculous or stiff, but visibly moved
reading.explain: Lvova says he is not ridiculous, not stiff, and one can see he is touched.

reading.ru: А вы, Долли?» Долли стояла подли них, слышала их, но не отвечала.
reading.question: How did Dolly react while standing near the other women discussing the wedding?
options: She was too moved to answer, on the verge of tears
reading.correct: She was too moved to answer, on the verge of tears
reading.explain: Dolly stood nearby, heard them, but did not answer; she was moved to tears.

reading.ru: Она вспомнила о них в то единственное торжественное для них время, когда они, так же как Китти, стояли под венцом с любовью, надеждой и страхом в сердце, отрекаясь от прошедшего и вступая в таинственное будущее.
reading.question: Which bride from Dolly's memories did she specifically recall, linked to a rumored divorce?
reading.explain: Among all the brides she remembered, Dolly recalled her dear Anna, about whose rumored divorce she had recently heard.

reading.question: What did the bystanders say about the groom's wealth?
options: That he was said to be extremely rich
That he was poor but noble
That his wealth was a rumor with no basis
That he had lost his fortune
reading.correct: That he was said to be extremely rich
reading.explain: Onlookers say he is said to be extremely ('terribly') rich.
